# MotifJS

> MotifJS is a UI framework for JavaScript and TypeScript (JSX/TSX) for long-lived, state-heavy browser apps. There is **no virtual DOM, no diffing, no re-render loop and no SSR**. Components own real DOM nodes; the `@motifx/compiler` compiler turns JSX expressions into fine-grained *bindings* that patch only the text node / attribute / list slot that depends on the changed reactive field.

MotifJS is not React, Vue, Solid or Angular, and no model has prior knowledge of it. The agent skill below
is the canonical text for writing MotifJS code: read SKILL.md first, then the reference that matches the task.
The complete skill in one file is at the end of this list.

## Agent skill

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/SKILL.md): entry point, Thinking in Motif, minimal project, rules that prevent most bugs
- [references/thinking-in-motif.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/thinking-in-motif.md): Design: component as object, model/view split, communication by scope, identity, rebuild vs fill, one page written both ways
- [references/setup.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/setup.md): Build setup, file extensions, opt-out markers, tsconfig
- [references/components.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/components.md): Component anatomy: constructor forms, props/childs, controls, refs, context, elementTag
- [references/jsx-and-reactivity.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/jsx-and-reactivity.md): JSX expression forms, attributes, `x-*` props, reactive primitives, bindings API
- [references/conditionals-lists-frames.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/conditionals-lists-frames.md): `x-wait`/`x-display`, `&&`, ternary, `.map`, `switch`, `Frame`, `Lazy`, `Transport` slots
- [references/events-and-forms.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/events-and-forms.md): DOM/component/app events, forms, two-way binding
- [references/lifecycle-and-dispose.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/lifecycle-and-dispose.md): Lifecycle order, show/hide, isWait, dispose, memory rules, wrapping third-party libraries
- [references/routing.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/routing.md): Routes, params, guards, `RouterView`, `RouterLink`, navigation
- [references/di.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/di.md): DI: ServiceCollection, `@Injectable`, `inject`, `getService`
- [references/styling-and-transitions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/styling-and-transitions.md): class/style helpers, CSS transitions, WAAPI
- [references/virtualization.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/virtualization.md): `Virtualization` for big lists
- [references/mobile-and-electron.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/mobile-and-electron.md): Phone-style page stack, swipe back, app lifecycle, Electron and `file://` apps
- [references/testing.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/testing.md): Writing Jest/jsdom tests for MotifJS components
- [references/api-cheatsheet.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/api-cheatsheet.md): Compact export list with signatures (incl. `Query`, error handling, `@motifx/core/devtools`)
- [references/pitfalls.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motifjsdev/skills/main/skills/motifjs/references/pitfalls.md): React-habit mistakes and known compiler/runtime quirks
- [Skill repository](https://github.com/motifjsdev/skills): install with `npx skills add motifjsdev/skills` or the Claude Code plugin marketplace

## Documentation

### Get started

- [MotifJS Documentation](https://motifjs.com/docs/index): What MotifJS does, the index of sections, and a quick look through a counter component.
- [Getting Started](https://motifjs.com/docs/getting-started): Set up the build, create a component and mount the application.

### Core concepts

- [Components](https://motifjs.com/docs/components): Class, function and Options API components; root element, props, childs, controls, content transport and ref.
- [JSX and Templates](https://motifjs.com/docs/jsx): JSX rules, reactive text and attributes, spread, class/style, x- directives, compile-time diagnostics and explain.
- [Reactivity](https://motifjs.com/docs/reactivity): reactive, createSignal, createComputed, createLazyComputed, effect, untracked and how bindings meet the DOM.
- [Conditional Rendering and Lists](https://motifjs.com/docs/conditionals-and-lists): x-wait/x-display, && and the ternary operator, .map lists, key and item identity, switch and the binding API.
- [Events](https://motifjs.com/docs/events): DOM events and modifiers, motif.on/off/trigger component events, lifecycle events and the application event bus.
- [Forms and Two-Way Binding](https://motifjs.com/docs/forms): One-way value+oninput, two-way binding with bindings.model and x-model, select, form submission and a validation pattern.
- [Lifecycle](https://motifjs.com/docs/lifecycle): Hook order, hooks as class methods and JSX props, initializeComponent, visibility, waiting, disposal and the application lifecycle.

### Application structure

- [Routing](https://motifjs.com/docs/routing): RouteItem definition, redirect/alias, route hooks, parameters, useRouter modes, scrollMemory, RouterView, links, programmatic navigation, guards, stack navigation and Lazy.
- [Dependency Injection](https://motifjs.com/docs/dependency-injection): Lifetimes, scoped handles, ServiceCollection registration forms, ServiceProvider resolution, @Injectable, inject, deps and service disposal.
- [Styling and Transitions](https://motifjs.com/docs/styling-and-transitions): class/style/attr helpers, inline <style>, the CSS class based transition prop, WAAPI keyframe transitions, visibility and the enter/leave mode.
- [Memory Management and Dispose](https://motifjs.com/docs/memory-and-dispose): What is cleaned automatically, motif.register/setDisposable, dispose methods, detach/silentDetach/silentUnlink, DisposableStore, using/doWork, leak monitoring and live component counting.
- [Error Handling](https://motifjs.com/docs/error-handling): The distinction between thrown, reported and warned errors; MotifError, errorHandler, setUnexpectedErrorHandler, the safeCall helpers and Emitter.
- [Resilience](https://motifjs.com/docs/resilience): Retry, timeout, circuit breaker, bulkhead, rate limiter and fallback policies through the Resilience.create chain; ordering, state and error codes.

### Guides

- [Wrapping Third-Party Libraries](https://motifjs.com/docs/wrapping-libraries): The rules for turning libraries that manage their own DOM into components; onMounted setup, setDisposable cleanup, untracked writes, DOM ownership conflicts, the root element and the single-copy rule.
- [Publishing an npm Library for MotifJS](https://motifjs.com/docs/publishing-libraries): Preparing an npm package containing MotifJS components, services or wrappers; package shape, build, types, CSS, the prop contract, testing and the release checklist.

### Reference

- [API Reference](https://motifjs.com/docs/api-reference): A quick reference of the symbols exported from the @motifx/core package and the table of MJX error/warning codes.
- [Collection Queries (Query)](https://motifjs.com/docs/query): LINQ-style where/select/orderBy/groupBy chains with Query.from, the result-producing methods and use with reactivity.
- [Collections](https://motifjs.com/docs/collections): The API and behaviour of the List, Dictionary, NameValuePair and LinkedList structures that ship with @motifx/core.

### Advanced

- [Frame](https://motifjs.com/docs/frame): A container holding one changing content; content changes with navigate, timing, leave transitions and the places where the framework sets up a Frame.
- [Lazy](https://motifjs.com/docs/lazy): Content loaded through a dynamic import or any Promise; the loading flow, options, retry, cancellation and error reporting.
- [Transport and TransportTo](https://motifjs.com/docs/transport): Showing content in a slot outside its own tree; the Transport slot, the TransportTo sender, the replace/merge modes and Transporter for programmatic moves.
- [ContentBody and ContentBlock](https://motifjs.com/docs/content-body): A body filled by several blocks together; the ContentBody body, ContentBlock pieces, accumulation, disposal and the difference from Transport.
- [Virtualization](https://motifjs.com/docs/virtualization): The Virtualization component; props reference, the dataRequest contract, templates, autoRefresh, filtering, the rendering model and methods.

## Source and packages

- [Source and issues](https://github.com/motifjsdev/motifjs)
- [@motifx/core on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@motifx/core): runtime
- [@motifx/compiler on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@motifx/compiler): JSX compiler, Vite plugin, motif-lint and motif-explain
- [Community projects](https://github.com/motifjs-community): reference apps and wrapper packages
